_status: values lifted from vendored source at code/experiments/d4-fader-intervention/analyse.py and code/experiments/d4-fader-intervention/harness.py (cybernaut6404/mg-digital-twin remote HEAD at vendoring date 2026-05-24); the original WORK_LOG.md references a local SHA f492844 that was never pushed to the GitHub remote, so the vendored source corresponds to the most-recent published state rather than that exact local SHA

model_loading.huggingface_revision_sha: main (not pinned in source code; harness.py loads via AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_id) with no revision= argument; replicator's effective revision is whatever HuggingFace main is at run time — record yours in your replication-log.md entry)
model_loading.device: cuda (Modal L4) | mps (local Mac fallback) | cpu (last resort)

decoding._note: Greedy decoding (do_sample=False) was used for all validation runs. Stochastic decoding may produce different generations; see manuscript §8.6.

diagnostic_only_psychopathy_sadism._note: Only psychopathy and sadism were run at c=4 per pre-specified diagnostic protocol.

judge.judge_temperature: Anthropic API default (no temperature= override in client.messages.create call; effective temperature is the API default, currently 1.0 unless changed by Anthropic)
judge._note_on_work_log_inconsistency: The publication's WORK_LOG.md §10 and ai-use-disclosure.md §2.1 refer to 'claude-opus-4-6 + claude-opus-4-7-1m' as the two judge model versions used. The vendored analyse.py at the published source HEAD names only 'claude-opus-4-7'. This is consistent with the local-SHA-not-pushed annotation: the originating session used the model name available at the time; the published source uses the model name that resolves at run time. Replicators should pin whichever Anthropic model is current at their run date and record it in their replication-log.md entry.
judge.permissive_parsing: Per analyse.py::judge_pair, the judge response is uppercased and stripped; 'TIE' in text → TIE; 'A' without 'B' → A; 'B' without 'A' → B; default fallback → TIE.

vector_normalisation: L2-normalised post-extraction; coefficient c is the intervention dial

_non_determinism.gpu_kernel_reduction_order: Qwen2.5-7B inference on Modal L4 is not bitwise-deterministic across runs due to floating-point reduction order. Documented in PROVENANCE.md §Determinism and manuscript §8.6.
_non_determinism.judge_temperature_default: The Anthropic API default temperature (currently 1.0) means each judge call is non-deterministic. With short max_tokens (10) and a forced-choice question with TIE fallback, the variance is typically low but non-zero; expect occasional κ jitter on re-run.

_completed_from_v0_intake: huggingface_revision_sha: confirmed not pinned in source; documented as 'HuggingFace main at run time'
judge_temperature: confirmed no override in analyse.py; Anthropic API default
